system.description:
When you would make an attack or cast a Jutsu affects a hostile creature, you can spend a superiority die to cripple a creature’s focus.

All affected creatures who would fail your Jutsu's saving throw gains 1 rank of Dazzled. If your attack does not force a saving throw then affected creatures must make a Charisma Saving throw vs your Jutsu’s save DC (If Weapon/Unarmed, Taijutsu save DC). On a failed save, they suffer the effects previously stated.
